verdict.rationale: Base44 explicitly documents a 'Bring your own AI coding agent' feature that connects external agents to its app sandbox, directly matching the story, and this is reinforced by CLI/SDK/GitHub sync options that let external tooling drive the project instead of the built-in AI. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an external agent actually replaces or works alongside the built-in builder, and detail on how conflicts or sync between agents is handled.
